responses: Hello! I am the Datheon Assistant. How can I assist you with your Python tasks today?
Hi there! Welcome. Feel free to ask questions about Datheon, Python, or project tasks.
Vanakkam! I'm ready to help you with your coding journey.
The Datheon Python Programming Internship is a 4-week industry-modeled engineering curriculum designed to build real portfolio proof.
Datheon empowers developers by pairing practical programming tasks with verifiable QR-coded certificates.
The final submission cutoff is Sunday, December 20, 2026. Make sure to commit and submit your public GitHub repository before this date.
You have a total of 28 calendar days. Final evaluation commences on Dec 20, 2026.

The internship comprises 5 tasks:
 1. Hangman Word Guessing Game (Console)
 2. Stock Portfolio Performance Tracker (CSV)
 3. Automated File Organizer & Cleanup Utility (OS/Pathlib)
 4. Rule-Based Interactive Chatbot (Regex/JSON)
 5. Enterprise Smart Inventory & Asset System (OOPs/ABC)
Rule: You must complete at least 2 to 3 tasks to qualify for certification. Completing all 5 qualifies for Letters of Recommendation!
All tasks are 100% built using Python 3 standard libraries (random, csv, os, shutil, pathlib, re, json, abc, unittest). No paid subscriptions or external API keys needed!
You can run the entire codebase on standard Python 3.10+ without any pip dependencies.
Once you submit your public GitHub repository, the Directorate reviews your code and issues a QR-coded verified certificate.
The certificate includes a unique verification hash and QR credential authenticated by Datheon.
Support is available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST via your student dashboard or official email.
You can reach out through the official Datheon portal for credential or technical queries.
Goodbye! Happy coding and best of luck on your Python internship submission!
Have a great day ahead! Remember to push your code regularly to GitHub.
See you! Feel free to return if you need more help.
